notes.title: Soul Device 1.4.1 Patch Note-Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused invulnerability to persist in certain situations

notes.title: Soul Device 1.4.0 + Controller(Gamepad) Support Patch
notes.notes:
v1.4.0 Patch Notes
Controller(Gamepad) Support
Improved player controls
Changes to player base stats and launch vehicle stats
Fixed an issue where jumping was possible when maneuvering was disabled
Fixed a bug with certain map layers
Fixed a bug where certain bosses could not be attacked with some weapons

notes.title: Soul Device 1.3.1 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Changing the price of the Contraband Shop
Changed the number of smuggled weapons generated from 1 to 2
Fixed inventory weapon class not changing after enhancing a weapon
Fixed an issue where Memory Shards would not save when obtained

notes.title: Soul Device 1.3.0 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Inventory Reorganization
Added player info window
Improved explosive weapon impact
Fixed abnormal screen shake on some weapons
Fixed some English text bugs

notes.title: Soul Device 1.2.0 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Adding New Goods
Added First Stage Bonus Items
Changed the required goods for the Contraband Shop
Increased player base stats and changed starting aircraft stats
Improved hit feel
Improved fragmentation
Fixed drop item UI displaying incorrectly in some languages and under certain conditions

notes.title: Soul Device 1.1.3 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Changed some weapon descriptions
Fixed some object interactions being blocked when pressing continue in the settings window
Fixed the Item Respawn UI button in the shop being disabled in certain situations
Fixed certain layer bugs on some maps
Change notification UI duration from 1 to 3 seconds
Added Russian

notes.title: Soul Device 1.1.2 hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed some images in the book
Fixed spawning in the New Weapon Shop
Fixed spawning in the New Weapons field
Added new weapons to the Smuggled Armory
We apologize for the serious bug.
We'll do our best to prevent this from happening again.
Thank you for your interest in the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Add 1 weapon
Added Steam Achievements, Cloud
Improved player controls
Some effects and sound improvements
Improved shop map height
Changed certain item stats
Changed prices in the contraband shop
Fixed an issue that caused players to move slower in certain situations
Fixed errors in the display of some book unlockings in certain situations
Japanese, Chinese, German, Turkish  Partial translation support

notes.title: SoulDevice Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with charging monsters crashing in certain situations
Fixed an overlapping bug with certain map background layers
